definitions.explanation: A school for children aged 12-15, covering grades 7-9 in Japan.

examples.japanese: {中学校|ちゅうがっこう}では{英語|えいご}を{習|なら}います。
examples.english: You study English in middle school.

examples.japanese: {息子|むすこ}は{中学校|ちゅうがっこう}2{年生|ねんせい}です。
examples.english: My son is in the second year of middle school.

examples.japanese: {中学校|ちゅうがっこう}を{卒業|そつぎょう}しました。

notes: 中学校 (often abbreviated to 中学 ちゅうがく) is the last stage of compulsory education in Japan. Students are called 中学生 (ちゅうがくせい). Many students also attend 塾 (juku, cram school) to prepare for high school entrance exams.
